SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND 1.0 * s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.School, s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
  AND s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  AND t.NumGE1500 = (
      SELECT MAX(t2.NumGE1500)
      FROM schools AS s2
      JOIN satscores AS t2 ON t2.cds = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.Charter = 1
        AND s2.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        COALESCE(s.School, sat.sname, s.District) AS School,
        s.District,
        s.County,
        sat.AvgScrWrite
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
      AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, District, County, AvgScrWrite
FROM ranked
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY School, District, County;

WITH county AS (
    SELECT `County Name` AS county_name
    FROM frpm
    WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`County Name` AS county_name,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter,
        ROUND(100.0 * f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 2) AS free_pct,
        ROUND(100.0 * f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 2) AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN county c ON f.`County Name` = c.county_name
    WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
),
sat_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM satscores
)
SELECT
    e.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(s.sat_total), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM eligible e
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school s ON s.cds = e.CDSCode
GROUP BY e.county_name;

SELECT
    sc.School AS school_name,
    sc.County AS county,
    sc.District AS district,
    sc.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_eligible_k12,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_eligible_percentage,
    s.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    s.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
    s.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
    s.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
    s.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_score_at_least_1500
FROM schools AS sc
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.CDSCode = '01612590137943';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
        f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Charter = 0
      AND CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) > 100
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
extremes AS (
    SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_count = (SELECT MAX(frpm_count) FROM eligible)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE frpm_share = (SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM eligible)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, CDSCode
    FROM eligible
    WHERE ltrim(CDSCode, '0') = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
    e.part,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.City AS city,
    s.MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    s.MailCity AS mailing_city,
    s.MailState AS mailing_state,
    s.MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    s.Website AS website,
    el.enrollment AS "K-12 enrollment",
    el.frpm_count AS "FRPM-eligible student count",
    el.frpm_share AS "FRPM share",
    (sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite) AS "average total SAT score",
    100.0 * sat.NumGE1500 / NULLIF(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS "percentage scoring 1500 or more",
    s.OpenDate AS opening_date,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM extremes AS e
JOIN eligible AS el ON el.CDSCode = e.CDSCode
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = e.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = e.CDSCode
ORDER BY
    CASE e.part
        WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
        WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    s.CDSCode;

SELECT s.cname AS county_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cds) AS qualifying_schools
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
 AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
GROUP BY s.cname
ORDER BY qualifying_schools DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(*) AS magnet_schools_with_provision_2
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` IN ('Provision 2', 'Breakfast Provision 2', 'Lunch Provision 2')
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL);

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE power IS NULL OR instr(power, '*') > 0
),
french AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT uuid
    FROM foreign_data
    WHERE language = 'French'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(f.uuid) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM qualifying q
LEFT JOIN french f ON f.uuid = q.uuid;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS count_sets
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND t.language = 'Italian';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(cardKingdomId) <> ''
             AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(cardKingdomFoilId) <> ''
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END
    ) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'CSP';

SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS year_span
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]';

WITH first_printing AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name
    FROM sets s
    JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
    ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC, s.code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_set AS (
    SELECT code, name
    FROM sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
selected_sets AS (
    SELECT code, name FROM first_printing
    UNION
    SELECT code, name FROM latest_set
)
SELECT
    s.name,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
                     AND TRIM(c.manaCost) <> ''
                     AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
            END
        ) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM selected_sets s
JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.code, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power <> '*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS official_ruling_count
FROM rulings
WHERE uuid IN (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Fireball'
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_printings
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
  AND layout <> 'normal';

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.uuid AS card_uuid,
        fd.name AS japanese_name,
        c.type AS english_type
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
      AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
per_printing AS (
    SELECT
        e.japanese_name,
        e.english_type,
        e.card_uuid,
        COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM eligible AS e
    LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
        ON r.uuid = e.card_uuid
    GROUP BY e.japanese_name, e.english_type, e.card_uuid
)
SELECT
    japanese_name,
    english_type,
    SUM(ruling_count) AS ruling_total
FROM per_printing
GROUP BY japanese_name, english_type
ORDER BY japanese_name, english_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data
WHERE language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit')
  AND (language <> 'Phyrexian' OR uuid IN (
      SELECT fd.uuid
      FROM foreign_data AS fd
      JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
      WHERE fd.language = 'Phyrexian'
        AND c.setCode = 'KHM'
  ))
GROUP BY language
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(printings)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS printings
        FROM foreign_data
        WHERE language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit')
          AND (language <> 'Phyrexian' OR uuid IN (
              SELECT fd.uuid
              FROM foreign_data AS fd
              JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
              WHERE fd.language = 'Phyrexian'
                AND c.setCode = 'KHM'
          ))
        GROUP BY language
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.colors = 'B'
  AND c.type LIKE '%Artifact%'
  AND f.language <> 'English'
  AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE p.ViewCount >= 1000
  AND ph.UserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;

WITH posts_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        p.Id,
        p.Score,
        p.LastEditorUserId,
        CASE
            WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(u.Location) LIKE '%germany%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS germany_editor
    FROM posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
german_editors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
    FROM posts_2012 AS p
    JOIN users AS u
        ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.germany_editor = 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN germany_editor = 1 THEN COALESCE(Score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN germany_editor = 0 THEN COALESCE(Score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS all_other_2012_posts_total_score,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM german_editors) AS germany_based_last_editor_user_count,
    (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(Reputation, 0)) FROM german_editors) AS combined_profile_reputation
FROM posts_2012;

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS pl
JOIN posts AS target ON target.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE (
    Location LIKE '%California%'
    OR Location LIKE '%, CA'
    OR Location LIKE '% CA'
    OR Location = 'CA'
)
AND Views = (
    SELECT MAX(Views)
    FROM users
    WHERE (
        Location LIKE '%California%'
        OR Location LIKE '%, CA'
        OR Location LIKE '% CA'
        OR Location = 'CA'
    )
);

WITH target_posts AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%' COLLATE NOCASE
),
related_posts AS (
    SELECT PostId AS target_id, RelatedPostId AS related_id
    FROM postLinks
    UNION
    SELECT RelatedPostId AS target_id, PostId AS related_id
    FROM postLinks
),
counts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT r.related_id) AS related_count
    FROM target_posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN related_posts AS r
        ON r.target_id = p.Id
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation), 2)
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    TRIM(u.Location) = 'India' COLLATE NOCASE
    OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '%, India' COLLATE NOCASE
    OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '%,India' COLLATE NOCASE
    OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '% India' COLLATE NOCASE
    OR TRIM(u.Location) LIKE '% India)' COLLATE NOCASE
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
      AND p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  );

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total, CustomerID
        ) AS rn
    FROM totals
),
selected AS (
    SELECT Segment, total
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN total END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN total END),
        2
    ) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM selected;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Consumption), 2)
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 15621
  AND Date LIKE '2013%'
  AND Consumption > 0;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS consumption_2012
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date >= '201201' AND Date <= '201212'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
averages AS (
    SELECT c.Currency, AVG(a.consumption_2012) AS avg_consumption
    FROM annual a
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
    GROUP BY c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM averages;

WITH height_extremes AS (
    SELECT id, player_name, height,
           MIN(height) OVER () AS min_height,
           MAX(height) OVER () AS max_height
    FROM Player
    WHERE height IS NOT NULL
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT id, player_name
    FROM height_extremes
    WHERE height = min_height OR height = max_height
),
averages AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.player_name, AVG(a.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM candidates AS c
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.id = c.id
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS a ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE a.finishing IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.id, c.player_name
)
SELECT player_name
FROM averages
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control END)
    - AVG(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control END)
        AS mean_ball_control_difference
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        volleys,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   AND r.rn = 1
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH player_appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS player_match_count
    FROM player_appearances AS a
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = a.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name, player_match_count
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_match_count = (SELECT MIN(player_match_count) FROM country_counts);

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        overall_rating,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE date <= '2013-07-12 23:59:59'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT p.player_name, r.overall_rating
    FROM ranked AS r
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
    WHERE r.rn = 1
      AND r.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
target AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM eligible
    WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (target.overall_rating - AVG(eligible.overall_rating))
    / AVG(eligible.overall_rating),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM eligible, target;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM trans t
      WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
        AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH served_youth_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
      AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_of_district_average_salaries,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM served_youth_districts AS s
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = s.district_id;

WITH eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS cd
      ON cd.district_id = c.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE cd.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp AS any_disp
          JOIN card AS ca
            ON ca.disp_id = any_disp.disp_id
          WHERE any_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM eligible_districts AS ed
JOIN district AS d
  ON d.district_id = ed.district_id;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
),
qualifying_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    JOIN cohort_accounts ca ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.amount > 4000
      AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(t.k_symbol) <> ''
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS household_payments,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol <> 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM qualifying_payments;

WITH card_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.type,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS p ON c.disp_id = p.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON p.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT type, district, inhabitants
FROM (
    SELECT
        type,
        district,
        inhabitants,
        MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY type) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM card_districts
)
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY type, district;

WITH withdrawal_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
order_by_district AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
accounts_by_district AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        w.total_withdrawn * 1.0 / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        COALESCE(ob.total_order_debit, 0) AS total_order_debit,
        abd.account_count
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal_by_district AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN accounts_by_district AS abd ON abd.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN order_by_district AS ob ON ob.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS district_rank,
    ROUND(total_order_debit * 1.0 / account_count, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY district_rank, district_name;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans AS t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    di.A2 AS district_name,
    di.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
    COALESCE(tt.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM gold_accounts AS ga
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, ga.account_id;

WITH cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980 THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919 THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980
       OR CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919
)
SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A12)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_districts cd
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cd.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH JapaneseEntries AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.laps
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
),
Winners AS (
    SELECT raceId, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN je.laps = w.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM JapaneseEntries je
JOIN Winners w ON w.raceId = je.raceId;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(l.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
   AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS milliseconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q1) <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q1_times AS t
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = t.driverId
WHERE t.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM q1_times);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_outqualified
FROM qualifying AS di_grassi
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
JOIN qualifying AS other_driver
  ON other_driver.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
 AND other_driver.position > di_grassi.position
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = di_grassi.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND lower(d.forename) = 'lucas'
  AND lower(d.surname) = 'di grassi';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 < '1:40.000';

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(q.q3) <> '' THEN 1 END) AS q3_laps
    FROM drivers AS d
    LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
        ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
      AND d.dob < '1992-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_laps), 2) AS avg_q3_laps_per_driver
FROM cohort;

SELECT d.code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
    FROM qualifying AS q2
    WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
      AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q2.q3) <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number AS permanent_race_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
  ) < 98000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS withdrew_drivers
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount END) * 1.0 /
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount END) AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.spent, 0)) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0)), 0) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name, spending_ratio
FROM event_ratios
WHERE spending_ratio = (
    SELECT MAX(spending_ratio)
    FROM event_ratios
);

SELECT
    a.department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.major_name) AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.major_name END) AS majors_held,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(m.member_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.major_id), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major AS a
LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = a.major_id
WHERE a.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
GROUP BY a.department
ORDER BY a.department;

WITH events_2019 AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM events_2019 AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT
    t.type AS event_type,
    COALESCE(a.member_count, 0) AS members_attended,
    COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget_dollars
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM events_2019) AS t
LEFT JOIN attendance_by_type AS a ON a.type IS t.type
LEFT JOIN budget_by_type AS b ON b.type IS t.type
ORDER BY event_type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount)
FROM income AS i
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.link_to_member IN (
      SELECT a.link_to_member
      FROM attendance AS a
      JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
      WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN budget AS xb ON xb.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE xb.link_to_event = e.event_id
      AND lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
)
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING MAX(b.amount) = (
    SELECT MAX(event_max)
    FROM (
        SELECT MAX(b2.amount) AS event_max
        FROM event AS e2
        JOIN budget AS b2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expense AS x2
            JOIN budget AS xb2 ON xb2.budget_id = x2.link_to_budget
            WHERE xb2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
              AND lower(x2.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
        )
        GROUP BY e2.event_id
    )
);

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE lower(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE lower(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-')
ORDER BY s.full_name;

WITH dc_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superhero d ON d.id = hp.hero_id
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = d.publisher_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
qualifying_marvel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.height_cm
    FROM superhero m
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = m.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = m.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND m.height_cm IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dc_powers d
          WHERE d.power_id = hp.power_id
      )
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height_cm
FROM qualifying_marvel;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad');

WITH genders AS (
    SELECT 'Male' AS gender, 1 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Female', 2
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT hero_id
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) >= 10
)
SELECT genders.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM genders
LEFT JOIN gender g ON g.gender = genders.gender
LEFT JOIN superhero s
    ON s.gender_id = g.id
    AND s.hair_colour_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM colour
        WHERE colour = 'Blue'
    )
    AND s.id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM qualifying)
GROUP BY genders.gender
ORDER BY genders.sort_order;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN race AS r ON s.race_id = r.id
  JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal'
    AND g.gender = 'Male'
  GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
  AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
  AND r.race <> '-'
GROUP BY r.id, r.race
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(race_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
        FROM superhero AS s2
        JOIN race AS r2 ON r2.id = s2.race_id
        WHERE s2.publisher_id = (
            SELECT publisher_id
            FROM superhero
            WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
        )
          AND s2.race_id IS NOT NULL
          AND r2.race <> '-'
        GROUP BY r2.id
    )
)
ORDER BY r.race;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg < 70;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE r.race = 'Human'
  AND s.height_cm = (
      SELECT MIN(s2.height_cm)
      FROM superhero AS s2
      JOIN race AS r2 ON r2.id = s2.race_id
      WHERE r2.race = 'Human'
        AND s2.height_cm IS NOT NULL
        AND s2.height_cm > 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-');

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) AS REAL)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5);

SELECT
    ID,
    SEX,
    CAST(
        strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday))
        AS INTEGER
    ) AS completed_age
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE GLU >= 180
        AND "T-CHO" < 250
  );

SELECT
    p.ID,
    CAST(
        (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday))
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
        AS INTEGER
    ) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT >= 52
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(p.Birthday, '+56 years') <= date('2026-10-09')
      AND l.PT >= 14
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_female
FROM cohort;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP = '+'
  AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT p.ID, l.Date, l.DNA
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(l2.DNA) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_ribonuclear_protein_value
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
  AND l.RNP GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX;
SELECT 0.00 AS percentage;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 600
  AND l.LDH < 800
  AND (
      CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
      OR l."U-PRO" IN ('>=300', '>=1000')
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND (
    CAST(`U-PRO` AS REAL) >= 300
    OR (
      `U-PRO` LIKE '>=%'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(`U-PRO`, 3) AS REAL) >= 300
    )
  )
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 4;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND (
          CASE
              WHEN u."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
                  THEN CAST(SUBSTR(u."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
              WHEN u."U-PRO" LIKE '+%(%'
                  THEN CAST(SUBSTR(
                      u."U-PRO",
                      INSTR(u."U-PRO", '(') + 1,
                      INSTR(u."U-PRO", ')') - INSTR(u."U-PRO", '(') - 1
                  ) AS REAL)
              WHEN u."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
                  THEN CAST(u."U-PRO" AS REAL)
              ELSE NULL
          END
      ) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND `First Date` >= '1998-01-01'
  AND `First Date` < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CASE SEX
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
    END AS sex,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RBC IS NOT NULL
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE (LOWER(a1.element) = 'p' AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'n')
   OR (LOWER(a1.element) = 'n' AND LOWER(a2.element) = 'p');

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_saturation AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bond b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                  AND b.bond_type <> '-'
            ) THEN 'other'
            ELSE 'all_single'
        END AS saturation_group
    FROM molecule AS m
)
SELECT
    saturation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule_saturation
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
END) AS atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
) AS rare ON rare.element = a.element
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(degree), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(c.atom_id2) AS degree
  FROM atom AS a
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  GROUP BY a.atom_id
);

SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN a.element < a2.element
            THEN a.element || '|' || a2.element
        ELSE a2.element || '|' || a.element
    END) AS element_pair_count,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
    ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;
